args: const fs=require('node:fs');const os=require('node:os');const path=require('node:path');const {pathToFileURL}=require('node:url');const roots=[process.env.CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT,process.env.PLUGIN_ROOT,process.env.CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT].filter(Boolean);const home=process.env.CODEX_HOME||path.join(os.homedir(),'.codex');const cache=path.join(home,'plugins','cache');try{for(const market of fs.readdirSync(cache)){const plugin=path.join(cache,market,'captain-sdlc');if(!fs.existsSync(plugin))continue;const versions=fs.readdirSync(plugin).sort((a,b)=>b.localeCompare(a,undefined,{numeric:true}));for(const version of versions)roots.push(path.join(plugin,version));}}catch{}const root=roots.find(value=>fs.existsSync(path.join(value,'dist','server.js')));if(!root)throw new Error('Captain SDLC MCP runtime not found');process.env.PLUGIN_ROOT=root;import(pathToFileURL(path.join(root,'dist','server.js')).href).then(module=>module.startCaptainMcp());
